summary: Frontend-only verification of two UI fixes on artirdim.com Laravel+Inertia/Vue app. (1) Scroll-to-top on auction detail after clicking a card from a scrolled home page — VERIFIED PASS on 2 different auctions. (2) Seller header decluttered into single 'Satıcı' dropdown grouping İlan Ver / İlanlarım / Satışlarım / Canlıya Başla — VERIFIED PASS on desktop (1920) and mobile compact '+' icon on 390px.

integration_issues.issue: Link href is correct (/seller/auctions/create) but after SPA navigation the URL resolved to '/' (home) instead of the create page. Likely app-level guard/redirect (KYC, wallet, or missing seller state) — unrelated to the header restructuring itself, but worth confirming by main agent.

action_items: Investigate why clicking [data-testid=seller-action-create] (href=/seller/auctions/create) lands on '/' — check middleware/guards or Inertia redirect. Header change itself is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: Home page and various authenticated views produce many 403 errors from notification/heartbeat polling endpoints (as noted in the task). Consider gating polling until user is fully authenticated / hiding 403 noise for unauthorized channels.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll fix verified: window.scrollY was 0 immediately and 500ms after clicking auction cards from a home page scrolled to y=1200/1500, for both mavi-beyaz-cini-vazo-uclusu-qdxU and vintage-yashica-fotograf-makinesi-Ing1. Seller header: on 1920x800 shows a single 'Satıcı' button with data-testid=seller-actions-toggle; clicking opens a dropdown with 4 items (İlan Ver testid=seller-action-create → /seller/auctions/create, İlanlarım → /seller/auctions, Satışlarım → /seller/sales, Canlıya Başla → /seller/dashboard). No standalone 'İlan Ver' remains in the header. Balance pill '0,00 ₺' still visible (class balance-pill d-none d-md-flex). On 390px viewport the dropdown is hidden and a compact icon-only anchor to /seller/auctions/create is visible instead. IMPORTANT NOTE for logout in future tests: /logout returns 405 on GET — clear cookies via context.clear_cookies() to switch users. Also, use page.expect_navigation() when calling form.requestSubmit() otherwise the URL check races.
rca of the issue: N/A — both requested UI fixes work as designed.
